grammar_focus: 复习 KS17/41/65 情态表达(方案B换情节包):must(必须;对现在的肯定推测)、have to / had to(客观上必须)、needn't 与 don't have to(不必)、should(应该、建议)的用法,以及 must 与 have to 的区别
scene: “我们该动手做饭了,”妈妈说,“爸爸六点到家。”“我们得先去买东西吗?”我问。“不用,该有的都有了。”“帮忙前你必须先洗手,”妈妈提醒我。“我来切菜吗?”我问。“好,不过用刀要小心。”“我们不用赶——晚饭六点半好就行。”“这汤闻着真香,一定特别好喝,”弟弟说。“做好了你尝尝,”妈妈笑道。“我们真该多一起做饭——太有意思了!”

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS17/41/65 情态表达
grammar_card.intro: 本课在做晚饭的场景里复习几个常用的情态说法:①must——“必须、务必”(You must wash your hands),也可表对现在的肯定推测“一定”(This soup must taste amazing);②have to / had to——客观上“不得不、必须”(Do we have to go shopping?);③needn't 和 don't have to——“不必、无需”(We needn't / We don't have to hurry);④should——“应该、建议”(We should start cooking soon);⑤must 与 have to 的区别:must 常表说话人主观的看法或强烈建议,have to 常表外在的客观要求。

rows: You must wash your hands. / This soup must taste amazing.
Do we have to go shopping first?
We needn't hurry. / We don't have to hurry.
must = 主观看法/建议;have to = 客观要求。

specialRules.rule: 美语“炉灶”说 stove(英式 cooker);“水龙头”说 faucet(英式 tap)。本课已按美语写。
needn't / don't have to = 不必;must 也可表“一定(推测)”;must 多表说话人主观强烈的看法或建议,have to 多表外在客观的要求。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — When will Dad be home for dinner?

passage: "We should start cooking soon," Mom said. "Dad will be home at six." "Do we have to go shopping first?" I asked. "No, we needn't. We have everything we need." "You must wash your hands before you help," Mom reminded me. "Should I chop the vegetables?" I asked. "Yes, but you must be careful with the knife." "We don't have to hurry — dinner needn't be ready until six-thirty." "This soup must taste amazing," said my brother. "It smells great!" "You should try it when it's done," Mom laughed. "We must cook together more often — it's fun!"
